name: Bern platform edges (SBB)
note: One line per track along the platform edge. Track 11 has no platform edge (through track); RBS 21-24 are not SBB infrastructure and are not in these datasets.

properties.note: height_cm = most common SBB norm height along the edge (P 55 = 55 cm above top of rail)
